idle.note: six key poses selected from the complete twelve-frame sleeping loop

waving.note: four-frame pure-wave excerpt from the complete twelve-frame master action

jumping.note: Codex-required five-slot hover row selects recognition, wave peak, low-clasp entry, the ready-and-expectant direct-gaze hold, and the near-neutral loop recovery

failed.note: symmetric eight-pose selection from the same sleeping loop used by idle

running.note: Codex task-running state mapped to the approved work cycle: blank page, marks, finished shrimp, page change, reset

segmentation.semantic_contour: anatomical core plus detached palette components of at least 80 pixels above the core baseline

adapter_transform.reference_weighting: equal state weight via median of state medians

contour_fit_constraint.rule: common_safe_target_ratio = min(contour_fit_scale / requested_feature_scale) across all frames; applied_scale = requested_feature_scale * common_safe_target_ratio
